findings.location: source.html — paragraph containing 'a great cloud of witnesses' (Hebrews 12:1-3) and its translation
findings.source_quote: “Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight... (Hebrews 12:1-3).”
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the Swedish word for 'witnesses' to standard spelling. Replace "vittnesskare" with "vittneskare" so the phrase reads naturally in contemporary Swedish.
findings.translation_quote: ”Därför, eftersom vi är omgivna av ett så stort vittnesskare, låt oss kasta av oss allt som tynger ...”

findings.location: source.html — paragraph with 'to the praise of his glory' (Ephesians 1 reference)
findings.source_quote: “You are accepted by God, and you are to be ‘to the praise of his glory!’”
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more natural, idiomatic Swedish rendering while preserving the theological meaning. Consider changing “till 'hans lof'!” to “till hans pris!” or “till hans ära!”
findings.translation_quote: "Du är accepterad av Gud, och du är till ”hans lof”!"
